data.data:
Beta Test II has officially begun! Everything on Talos-II awaits your exploration, Endministrator.


▼// Test Period

2025-11-27 22:00 (UTC-5) – End of Test

* End time to be announced


▼// Test Overview

Test Type: Limited-access, free of charge, data-wipe test

Platforms: PC & Mobile (Android/iOS)


▼// Important Notes

1. All content available for experience in the [Beta Test II] is from a work-in-progress build. The content, such as the story, settings, stats, and visual presentation may differ significantly from the launch version and does not represent the final look and quality of the game.

2. The test server will be closed and all data will be deleted after the test ends.

3. Endministrator, please make sure to keep your personal account secure. Do not trust any information regarding account trading, account sharing, or the sale of test installation packages to avoid unnecessary losses.


▼// Feedback and Suggestions

If you have any issues or suggestions during the Beta Test II, feel free to share with us via in-game Customer Support ([Settings] > [Contact Customer Support]) or the Beta Test II surveys.


Once again, thank you for your continued interest and support for Arknights: Endfield, Endministrator!
